records.part: Relocation of fire hydrants, water and sewer service laterals, service boxes, cleanouts, water mains, isolation valves, and sewer manholes

records.part: Replace 52" metal culvert with new Double Wall 60" HDPE Culvert Pipe at Ramirez/Cordua turnout
records.reason: This pipe is the sole source of water to the Ramirez Pumping Plant, so it’s failure during water delivery season would be catastrophic for the water customers
records.installed_location: Ramirez Water District turnout from Cordua canal

records.part: Low density SCADA System for remote monitoring/control of surface water diversion pumps
records.reason: Efficiencies will be improved by installing a low density Scada System, updated flow meters, and level sensors in the main distribution canal that would communicate with the pumps at the river diversion to automatically adjust the flow to maintain the required level in the canal upon demand.
records.installed_location: Plumas Mutual Water Company irrigation distribution system, South Yuba County
